availability: Production server is not configured. Offline racing is available.
release_notes: Free Touch responds to a stationary press. The same held steering finger can move through the neutral center and steer the opposite way without lifting.

Existing Android steering modes migrate once to Free Touch so old wheel or joystick settings no longer require a drag to start steering. Optional modes selected after this repair stay saved; pedals, car selection, key bindings, audio and progress are preserved.

Mobile side barriers and catch fences restore the original track positions, atlas UVs, normals, tangents and triangle winding in both detailed and distant sections. Authored transparency preserves overlapping fence layers; mipmapped fence atlases filter the fine grid at a distance.
Other mobile track geometry, original desktop assets, collision geometry, shared vehicle physics and protocol 4 are unchanged. Camera-frustum and per-mesh visibility culling remain active.

Press/hold/swipe, multitouch, saved-mode migration, source-fence integrity and existing game/network regression checks validate this repair. Native Windows captures exercise mobile assets; they do not establish Android performance.
Development preview: exact phone installation, rendering, FPS, touch, resume and phone/Windows crossplay remain unverified. Public multiplayer is still not provisioned.
limitations: Physical Android installation testing remains incomplete.
Physical Android + Windows multiplayer testing remains incomplete.
Physical Android Low/Medium/High graphics qualification remains incomplete.
Final Android Low/Medium/High rendering, touch, lifecycle and phone/Windows cross-play remain unverified.
Public multiplayer is not provisioned. Render integration is not connected; localhost gateway tests do not establish internet cross-play.
Free Render shared CPU capacity, cold wake and eight simultaneous human clients remain unmeasured.
Automatic content updates support signed allowlisted images; map geometry, audio and application code use complete packages.
